content.rendered:
Dreaming of a career in the skies? Your journey begins here!

With the upcoming Navi Mumbai International Airport (NMIA) set to revolutionize India’s aviation sector, the demand for skilled aeronautical engineers is about to take off!

A. C. Patil College of Engineering, Kharghar, proudly launches a new B.E. in Aeronautical Engineering (affiliated to the University of Mumbai) starting 2025 — right next to the future aviation hub!

Unlock career opportunities in aircraft maintenance, airport operations, drone tech, and more. Learn from expert faculty, gain hands-on experience, and fly high with industry partnerships!

Admissions open soon!

Location: Plot No. 17, Sector 4, Near Kharghar Railway Station, Navi Mumbai – 410210
